She took a room above the chandler’s, where the window
faced the marsh. |plants|Reeds|| ran out to the horizon and a
single |animal|heron|| stood in them, patient as a fence post. By
evening she had drawn the room, the stair, and the
street as far as the pump, because drawing a place was
the only way she knew of arriving in it.

On the |times|third day|| a boy came to the door and said he
could carry things. His name was Tomás and he was
|numbers=11|eleven||, or would be at {h_p8_candle}Candlemas{h_p8_candle}. His mother sold |animals|eels||
from a barrow and called every stranger {s_p8_senora}señora{s_p8_senora/}
regardless of evidence. Ada hired him for |numbers=2|two|| pence a
day and a share of whatever the {c_p8_marsh}marsh turned out to
contain.{c_p8_marsh/}
